svg.aria-label: Drawing CLR-PT-302: CLEAR POINT LARGE · PAY CASE
svg.text: 1. FOR THE POINT LARGE (173 × 114) AND A STRIPE READER M2 (73.5 × 67 × 19.5), BOTH AS SUPPLIED.
2. TWO PARTS: FRONT SHELL AND BACK PLATE, 4 × M3 INTO INSERTS. PROTOTYPE PETG; PRODUCTION CNC OR DIE-CAST ALUMINIUM,
3. BUTTONS: 16 MM STAINLESS ANTI-VANDAL, MOMENTARY, RING LIGHT. LEFT CALLS STAFF, RIGHT ASKS FOR THE BILL. POGO PINS
4. THE POINT'S OWN TAP TAG SITS BEHIND THE CASE LIP, SHIELDED BY A STEEL SHIM, SO A PHONE ONLY MEETS THE READER.
5. THE READER CHARGES FROM ONE USB-C CABLE THROUGH THE BOTTOM; THE POINT FROM ITS OWN PORT INSIDE.
